name: Barking and Dagenham
note: No zones: the 2022 policy says there is too little evidence of cumulative impact anywhere in the borough.

name: Barnet
note: One off-licence zone in Burnt Oak, adopted in 2020, whose status is unclear because the 2025 policy does not appear to list it.

name: Bexley
note: Two zones covering all premises, in Bexleyheath and Welling town centres, which the council calls saturation areas.

name: Brent
note: Twelve zones, all for off-licences only, along high streets across the borough; no review of the 2022 assessment has been found.

name: Bromley
note: No zones since April 2025: Bromley and Beckenham town centres were dropped after a 2024 review found too little evidence.

name: Camden
note: No zones since 2025: Camden Town and Seven Dials were dropped after a 2023 assessment found too little evidence.

name: City of London
note: No zones: the City decided against them in its 2022 policy, and its draft 2027 policy still has none.

name: Croydon
note: Five zones, all for off-licences only, on main roads and parades across the borough; all kept after a review in March 2026.

name: Ealing
note: Four zones covering alcohol sales, in Acton, Greenford, Hanwell and Ealing, and Southall, redrawn from five in July 2025.

name: Enfield
note: Six zones covering all premises at all hours, including two added at Bowes and Palmers Green in January 2025.

name: Greenwich
note: Seven zones covering all premises, unchanged in the January 2026 policy, plus a new match-day policy area around The Valley.
unmapped: 1 not drawn: The Valley Stadium policing footprint

name: Hackney
note: One zone in Shoreditch, re-created in April 2025, plus a softer special consideration area in Dalston, which may account for its Home Office count of two.

name: Hammersmith and Fulham
note: No zones since 2021: the Fulham and Shepherd's Bush zones lapsed when their evidence expired and were not renewed in 2022.

name: Haringey
note: No zones; a possible off-licence zone on parts of High Road N17 and West Green Road was flagged for separate work in 2026.

name: Harrow
note: No zones: the 2023 policy has no cumulative impact section, and no earlier zone has been found.

name: Havering
note: Three zones, in Romford and Hornchurch town centres and an off-licence zone in Harold Hill, under a policy that reached its five-year term in September 2026.

name: Hillingdon
note: No zones: the 2026 policy says Hillingdon lacks the concentration of licensed premises found in central London.

name: Hounslow
note: Three zones in the policy (Hounslow town centre, Heston and Cranford), though Hounslow reports one area to the Home Office.

name: Inner Temple
note: No zones: the Inn's 2022 policy rules out zoning its precincts.

name: Islington
note: Six area zones plus a borough-wide off-licence policy, which the Home Office count of six appears to leave out; a review due December 2025 has not been found.

name: Kensington and Chelsea
note: No zones: the council found too little evidence in 2025, though a consultation response asked for zones in Earl's Court and on the King's Road.

name: Kingston upon Thames
note: No zones since 2021, when the Kingston town centre zone was removed; the 2026 policy again decided against one.

name: Lambeth
note: One zone, along Clapham High Street, in force since 2011; no separate cumulative impact assessment for it has been found.

name: Lewisham
note: No zones since New Cross and Blackheath were dropped in 2020; a review considering zones is intended for a new policy from April 2027.

name: Merton
note: Two zones: Wimbledon town centre for all premises, and Mitcham town centre for off-licences only.

name: Middle Temple
note: No zones recorded in Home Office returns; no published licensing policy has been found.

name: Newham
note: Five zones since April 2024, replacing a much larger zone that lapsed in March 2023.

name: Redbridge
note: Three zones covering all premises (Ilford, South Woodford and Gants Hill), plus nine district policies that set expectations but no presumption of refusal.
unmapped: 8 not drawn: Seven Kings & Goodmayes, Ilford Lane (parts not in the Ilford Town CIZ), Wanstead & Snaresbrook, Barkingside, Woodford Bridge, Woodford, Chadwell Heath, Hainault

name: Richmond upon Thames
note: Two zones, in Richmond and Twickenham town centres, under review in a draft policy out to consultation until 25 October 2026.

name: Southwark
note: Three zones (Borough and Bankside, Camberwell and Peckham) under review, with a new Elephant and Castle zone proposed in July 2026, plus two monitoring areas.

name: Sutton
note: No zones since July 2023, when Sutton town centre and North Cheam were dropped for lack of evidence.

name: Tower Hamlets
note: One zone, Brick Lane, enlarged in November 2024, when the Bethnal Green zone was removed.

name: Waltham Forest
note: No zones since July 2022, when the Walthamstow and Leytonstone zones were removed from the policy.

name: Wandsworth
note: Three zones since July 2025, Wandsworth's first: off-licences in Tooting and Clapham Junction, and late-night takeaways on Putney High Street.

name: Westminster
note: One zone in the West End, much reduced on 1 October 2026, plus eight softer special consideration zones.
